title.en: An Act Creating Another Position of Labor Attorney for the Province of Negros Occidental, to be Assigned in Bacolod City
title.orig: An Act Creating Another Position of Labor Attorney for the Province of Negros Occidental, to be Assigned in Bacolod City

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3074_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby created another position of labor attorney for the Province of Negros Occidental, to be assigned in Bacolod City, with an annual compensation of three thousand one hundred eight pesos.
Said labor attorney shall be under the direct supervision and control of the Department of Labor. He shall perform the same duties and functions which are now exercised by labor attorneys.

There is hereby appropriated the sum of three thousand one hundred eight pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act during the fiscal year nineteen hundred and sixty-two. Such sum as may be needed in subsequent years for the same purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961.
